fields.staffing: Full shifts in Operations, Maintenance and IT
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 09:00 AM on a busy Thursday. The weather is clear and passenger load is high due to a holiday weekend. Terminal, airfield and IT are all operating normally. Begin your shift.
fields.facilitatorNote: Confirm every table has the player briefing packet and a blank ICS 201 before reading. Remind players to start and end every radio or phone call with "This is an exercise."
